decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (D1126-1, Design & Access Statement, K2_189_(2-)_A001 Rev P01, K2_189_(2-)_A002 Rev P01, Received: 26/10/2016. CES Noise Acoustics Report - J2740 (dated: 04/08/2016), LCP Acoustic Consultancy/Diagnostic Report - 81957/3/1/3 (dated: 20/12/2016), Received: 04/01/2017. Unnumbered Acoustic Panel Details, Received: 11/01/2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - A solid 75mm acoustic panel screen with a height of 900mm above the extract fan shall be installed within three months of the date of this permission in the location  shown in Appendix C of the LCP Acoustic Consultancy/Diagnostic Report - 81957/3/1/3 (dated: 20/12/2016) and at the same distance from the plant hereby approved on the other three sides of the installation to the specification given in the associated report and the screen shall be permanently retained thereafter unless the plant associated with it is removed from the roof and is not replaced.
Condition : 3 - The noise generated by the development shall not result in a noise level that exceeds 36 dB at the fa?ade of the nearest sensitive receptor at any time.

Condition : 4 - The machinery hereby approved shall not operate before 9am on weekdays and Saturdays and 10am on Sundays/Bank Holidays nor after 8pm on weekdays and 7:30pm on Saturdays and 7pm on Sundays/Bank Holidays.
description: Retrospective application for the erection of mechanical equipment consisting of six Condensing units, one attenuator and an acoustic screen
